scope: set the client incomingSequence to 2 so it expects our seq=3, then observe

crucial_ordering_problem.what_happened: forward had already delivered the three gamestate fragments (seq=3) before we patched the sequence field, so the client judged them against incomingSequence=1 (expecting 2) and dropped them
crucial_ordering_problem.fix: patch conn+0x34 BEFORE the gamestate is sent, then send
crucial_ordering_problem.how: run connect, then patch, then start-challenge - or issue forward with a delay long enough to patch in between

why_this_is_the_best_remaining_lead.consistent_with_every_failure: if the client rejects out-of-order sequences before payload parsing, then byte-perfect payloads fail exactly as observed
why_this_is_the_best_remaining_lead.testable_in_one_round: patch then send is a single ordering change with a binary outcome
